name: Yevsenia Nevelskaya
source:
Symbiont: Lactarius Torminosus

Yevsenia lives in the Overworld with her overprotective parents. She suffered an eye injury a few years ago, but it doesn't interfere with her hobbies or work. She uses an implant to navigate the world around her. 

She visits Euphemia and Vikul at the laboratories from time to time.
